policy_parameters.description: 1-4 family residential mortgage — conforming and jumbo
policy_parameters.regulatory_notes: RESPA, TILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure (TRID), HMDA, QM / Ability-to-Repay rule (12 CFR 1026.43), CRA community reinvestment tracking required. HOEPA triggers apply at APR + 1.5pp over APOR for first liens.

regulatory_compliance_checklist.requirement: Loan Estimate within 3 business days of application
Closing Disclosure ≥ 3 business days before closing
Ability-to-Repay documentation; QM safe harbor if qualifying
HMDA LAR filing for covered institutions
GFE / CFPB TRID replaces legacy GFE
High-cost mortgage triggers at APR + 1.5pp over APOR (1st lien)
Mortgage origination tracked for CRA assessment area
Adverse action notice identifies Plaid as data source and provides contact details
End-user OAuth consent captured via Plaid Link; consent record retained 7 years
Plaid bank data included in data-subject access and erasure workflows
Plaid API credentials stored in secrets manager; not in code or config files
